text.Siege Fortress:
How to play ==
At any time during your turn, gain 5 Combat. If you have another Star Empire card in play, gain an additional 4 Combat. Siege Fortress is an outpost with defense 5. 
 Strategy ==
Much like an upgraded version of War World in the base game, this base breathes massive combat power. With a single ally it can yield 9 Combat, which is massive for a base, but even without allying its 5 Combat can be considered high by any means. Because of this it is often the first target of opponents. Unfortunately it is relatively easy for them to take it down, since it is an outpost (and hence can be targetted first) and has a defense of 5 which is relatively low considering the cost of 7 Trade.
